forward_rule.none_feasible_requires: Every bank action demonstrably infeasible; missing truth is not that proof.
forward_rule.power_population: Reference-feasible opportunity subset under separately declared diagnostic Q; never replace P.

variant.recommendation: Keep grids as audit baseline; prefer continuous supported intervals after bank winner-diversity and close-call measurement; owner selects.

P.recommendation: Uniform supported context/grid mass or uniform supported continuous threshold density; freeze support and dependencies, not equal mass on unequal-volume answer cells.

Q.recommendation: 0.5 P + 0.5 P conditioned on a prospectively frozen positive-mass near-limit region; use P and report no enrichment if empty. Power reports use the feasible-opportunity subset.

w.recommendation: Actual P/Q mass or density ratio for an adopted population-mean diagnostic only; raw Q reported separately; not adopted score weights.

q2_selection.recommendation: Up-to counts, not existing pools. Predeclare reference-supported boundary regions and use a frozen independent panel's disagreement, never candidate errors; missing panel predictions mean unavailable.

near_limit_bands.recommendation: Quantity-specific bands from separately accepted reference/refinement evidence; packet convergence limits are not certified uncertainty.

refined_truth.recommendation: Before key seal refine every required limit-crossing action and possibly optimal competitor on the same physical deck, with separately pinned bounded rungs; otherwise retain UNRESOLVED. Interval construction, equality, stopping and budget need adoption.

controls.recommendation: Four named decision behaviours and two good baselines; magnitudes, regions, recipes, mixtures and admission remain to be registered. A control is bad only where it causes its defined error.

power_and_thresholds.recommendation: Test Lead selects score use, acceptance thresholds, tail definitions, target power and recipes; absent class support is UNMEASURABLE.

winner_diversity.recommendation: Report observed winners and P/Q expected occupancy sum_a[1-(1-p_a)^k] excluding NONE_FEASIBLE/UNRESOLVED; actual joint law replaces iid formula under exposure constraints. Do not redraw for diversity.

exposure.recommendation: Use separately approved E and remaining ledger; one question per underlying window draw pending a bundle policy. Threshold variants, arms, replay and refinement never renew E; retired published cases never return to hidden use.

disclosure.recommendation: Future allow-listed projection omits registered starts, seed, bank order and protected linkage; this sheet contains no realized cases or keys.

diagnostics.a: optimizer stability: committed pick/verdict agreement and physical regret under predeclared comparators
diagnostics.b: grid resolution: matched numerical refinement distinct from new design-action witnesses
diagnostics.c: power by k: good/bad discrimination on reference-feasible opportunities under Q with shared-bank clusters
diagnostics.d: agreement with decision value: independent comparator rank, feasibility, best-pick agreement or buyer-unit regret
diagnostics.e: unresolved rate: all-draw and eligible denominators, reference/optimum/refinement/candidate coverage separated

permitted: separate non-hidden draw from supported distribution
witness_custody.tool_disagreement: Reference finding; versioned future revision, never candidate failure or silent historical rescore. Report pointwise and decision agreement.

challenges.customer_job: Maximize useful extra burst joules without overheating the die.
q2_strata: thermal ceiling both sides and energy floor
challenges.panel: One of 24 contexts; nine schedules in that context. Spatial-temporal top-die maximum over 120 s; extra energy above base integrated from the exact waveform.

q3_law.objective: Max extra J; frozen action order for ties.

challenges.refinement: Same physical stack/waveforms; independent mesh/time and internal event-peak/crossing search. Packet 0.5 degC/0.5 s shifts and 1 degC unresolved band do not calibrate new bands; RC screen is not truth.

control_focus.edge-optimist: Understate a failing die peak or inflate ramp extra J.
control_focus.over-cautious: Reject a settled feasible high-energy schedule.
control_focus.sign-error: Reverse thermal or energy passing margin in a declared region.
control_focus.optimizer-or-lattice-aware: Hide a covered event/second-pulse peak at search-favoured energy; no invented off-lattice schedules.

reference_route.gap: Exact layered-stack deck/environment/source/observer and adequate spatial-time bank.

base_work.condition: 9 schedules x 24 contexts; additional steady recovery baselines, controls and mesh/time refinement excluded.

challenges.customer_job: Pick a manufacturable mask with robust fiber coupling and limited reflection.
q2_strata: coupling/reflection boundaries both sides and intersections
challenges.panel: All 9 tolerance vectors x 5 wavelengths; both hard limits at every point. Finite 45-point nearest-rank p10 is the fifth ordered coupling, not continuous-band yield.

q3_law.objective: Max frozen 45-point p10 coupled fraction; frozen bank order.

challenges.refinement: Same deck at 30/20/10 nm with independently checked PML/padding/time/normalization. Packet 0.02 coupling and 0.01 reflection deltas are convergence checks, not certified decision intervals.

control_focus.edge-optimist: Overstate coupling or understate reflection on a failing tolerance point.
control_focus.over-cautious: Reject a settled feasible robust mask.
control_focus.sign-error: Reverse coupling/reflection passing margins without inventing negative power.
control_focus.optimizer-or-lattice-aware: Fit coarse mask/spectral probes but bias independently covered perturbation or search-favoured witnesses.

reference_route.gap: Exact normalization/TE0/fiber-overlap deck, fine-grid memory fit and adequate tolerance bank; old supermode route is not this task.

fine_grid_memory.unavailable_fine_truth: UNRESOLVED; no silent coarse substitution, GPU grant or spend.

base_work.condition: 256 masks x 9 vectors ONLY IF one verified broadband solve resolves all 5 wavelengths; otherwise additional spectral work; normalization/controls/refinement excluded.

challenges.customer_job: Choose a support with low worst-band motion within mass and static stiffness limits.
q2_strata: mass/static/dynamic boundaries both sides and intersections
challenges.panel: Complete adaptive 80-600 Hz band at all three damping values 0.005/0.01/0.02; static and geometry mass observations. Not strength, fatigue or settling-time truth.

q3_law.objective: Min worst dynamic compliance; secondary mass, then frozen bank order.

challenges.refinement: Independent mesh/modes/resonance brackets; packet 12/24/48 modes where supported, 1% eigenfrequency, 5% peak, min(2 Hz,1% frequency) peak location, 5-degree phase; spacing at most 0.1 half-power bandwidth. No damping increase to obtain agreement.

control_focus.edge-optimist: Understate a failing resonance, static compliance or mass.
control_focus.over-cautious: Reject a settled feasible lightweight support.
control_focus.sign-error: Reverse compliance/mass passing margin in a declared region.
control_focus.optimizer-or-lattice-aware: Fit coarse frequency/design nodes but hide a covered narrow resonance or search-favoured design.

reference_route.gap: Exact CAD deck/build/complex extractor and adequately resolved modes/peak bank.

base_work.condition: 256 x (static + eigen + three harmonic), assuming one process per study; controls/refinement excluded; route must be verified.

challenges.customer_job: Select a compact passive geometry with useful lower-tail no-flow attenuation.
q2_strata: p10/length/diameter boundaries both sides and intersections
resolved transmission notches changing p10 or pick
challenges.panel: Complete no-flow 500-2500 Hz power-TL curve with interval-weighted p10; minimum TL diagnostic only. No every-frequency 5 dB or pressure-loss constraint.

q3_law.objective: Max interval-weighted band p10 TL; frozen bank order.

challenges.refinement: Mesh and frequency quadrature independently; packet 0.5 dB mesh, 10 Hz resonance and 0.25 dB p10/mean changes, 1% balance. Absolute-power/log applicability and quantile uncertainty HUMAN_INPUT; sparse preflight cannot certify p10.

control_focus.edge-optimist: Mask low-TL intervals to inflate p10 or understate package size.
control_focus.over-cautious: Reject a settled feasible compact attenuator.
control_focus.sign-error: Reverse p10/length/diameter passing margin without active-gain fiction.
control_focus.optimizer-or-lattice-aware: Fit sparse frequency/CAD nodes but hide covered notch or quadrature behaviour.

reference_route.gap: Exact port/deck/energy extractor and full adaptive curve; no verified multi-frequency process route.

base_work.condition: 16 x 201 only under separately launched frequencies; batched route must be measured/versioned and cannot erase frequency work; controls/refinement excluded.

challenges.customer_job: Choose grooves with useful mixing and acceptable pump burden and residence.
q2_strata: mixing/pressure/residence boundaries both sides and intersections
flux variance, volume residence and reference balance
challenges.panel: All 1/3/5 uL/min x 0.5/1/2 x 1e-10 m2/s conditions. Positive axial-flux weighted mixing; actual fluid-volume/flow residence, not residence-time distribution.

q3_law.objective: Max worst mixing index across nine conditions; frozen bank order.

challenges.refinement: Independent groove/mesh/velocity/scalar layers, especially maximum Pe; packet 0.5% balance, c[-0.001,1.001], 0.02 M and 5% pressure shifts. Boundedness is not diffusion adequacy; flow and scalar processes charged separately.

control_focus.edge-optimist: Smooth scalar variance to inflate M or understate pressure/residence.
control_focus.over-cautious: Reject a settled feasible useful-mixing cartridge.
control_focus.sign-error: Reverse M/pressure/residence passing margin without concentration clipping.
control_focus.optimizer-or-lattice-aware: Fit coarse grooves/easy flow but bias covered maximum-Pe or search-favoured grooves.

reference_route.solver: OpenFOAM laminar flow and passive scalar
reference_route.gap: Exact grooved deck/flow-scalar build/flux observer and adequate bank; cooling installation is not this route.

base_work.condition: 45 geometries x 9 conditions x 2 processes if both run per pair; no assumed velocity reuse; controls/refinement excluded.
